study.question: Does the small incremental utility of raw target-conditioned fusion require the retrieved vector direction, or can its scalar norm modulating the pre-existing pooled vector suffice?
study.hypothesis: The norm constraint may hide a useful target-conditioned scalar amplitude rather than uniquely useful directional evidence. Replace the raw retrieved vector r by ||r|| p/||p||, where p is the existing global history mean. This removes target-conditioned directional readout information while retaining one scalar amplitude. If radius_target retains the raw_target advantage over pooled_reference and radius_context, amplitude sufficiency is provisionally supported; if raw_target is better, direction or its interaction with amplitude remains necessary. This is a diagnostic candidate, not a prediction that it beats the incumbent.

nearest_work.difference: DIN uses ad-conditioned unnormalized weighted sums to retain activation intensity. Here group softmax and equal occupied-group mass remain; the experiment transplants the Euclidean norm of a normalized weighted average to the already available pooled direction. It neither implements DIN unnormalized mass nor establishes novelty.
Exact frozen parent source checked by SHA256. Parent emits raw direction and radius jointly; this replacement transmits only raw radius on global pooled direction, with no new parameter.

Existing normalized target cell supplies target direction with pooled radius; pooled source is the stronger utility reference. New pooled_reference supplies pooled direction and pooled radius with the same residual head allocation, completing a radius-by-direction replacement table across existing and new trials.

nearest_work.source_ref: unidot-paper-v1; arxiv:2608.16797v1; archived primary text lines 693-740, Table 4
nearest_work.difference: Source FM Highway and bus fusion are not adopted. Tiny-mode fusion removal trades improved AUC against worse Logloss, supporting separate reporting of both metrics rather than transferring a component conclusion.

inherited_components: Exact complete pooled_observed predictor including all feature, identity, context, repeat, overlap, chronological-product and observed-gap paths.

Frozen category/brand/action/log-age encoders, target-match groups, equal occupied-group mass, separate category and brand retrieval, scorer, raw scale, 16-wide summary and 32-wide zero-final residual head.

Same parameter names, allocation order, scratch RNG draws, loss, Adam default, learning rate, host 3 epochs, training exposures, masks, seeds, causal history_limit=128, validation scorer and static snapshot assumption.
Existing source bests and all successful/null matched fusion trajectories retained; no failed execution is supplied in this context.
study.proposed_difference: For radius_target and radius_context append ||r|| times the unit direction of global mean p. For pooled_reference append p with a zero-scaled radial path. If ||p||<=1e-6 use zero, never raw direction; report incidence and lost norm. No learned scale, extra head, new input, label path, optimizer change or cache. Both new geometry modes compute the same target or context raw retrieval before replacement. Existing direction-only cell uses ||p|| r/||r|| with its original fallback and raw cell uses r. These four cells form an approximate geometric factorial outside the explicitly reported near-zero cases; they are independently trained models, not interventions on one frozen embedding.
predictions: Existing observations: raw_target AUC=0.6307203236894126 versus pooled_observed=0.6302753100663608, normalized target=0.6303714619147884, raw_context=0.6303822658190372 and raw_pooled_duplicate=0.6303451590786613. Raw target Logloss=0.1926675814945728 versus pooled=0.19281129507058942. These are seed-42 observations, not significance evidence.

Mechanism prediction: radius_target exceeds pooled_reference and radius_context and lies within a predeclared practical AUC tolerance of 0.0001 of raw_target if scalar amplitude is sufficient. Equivalence is not established by a single seed or by absence of significance; use paired repetitions and user-cluster intervals if host supports them.

Outside near-zero p, radius_target has ||summary||=||r|| and summary is collinear with p. Pooled_reference is exactly reconstructible from existing group means and sizes. Empty and zero-length histories produce zero appended summaries; mask padding and input permutations preserve summary to floating tolerance.

Allocated capacity remains 17270691 parameters (17568 appended head, 4226 inherited scorer). Reference scorer is inactive by design. Measured training and inference costs should be close to raw_target but no efficiency improvement is assumed.
falsifiers: Repeated radius_target AUC falls more than 0.0001 below raw_target: scalar amplitude alone does not retain its utility under this parameterization; direction or direction-radius interaction remains plausible.
Radius_target does not outperform pooled_reference or radius_context after paired repetition: a target-specific scalar mechanism is unsupported.
Any observed advantage disappears or reverses against pooled_observed after repetition, or Logloss/cost are unacceptable: no supported utility improvement.
Failure of source reproduction, collinearity/norm/mask/finite checks or substantial unsupported pooled norm cases invalidates the intended contrast before any scientific conclusion.
alternative_explanations: Single-seed variation and repeated validation selection can explain differences of a few ten-thousandths.
Gradients through norm and pooled direction change embedding optimization; geometry replacement is a trained-system intervention, not an isolated mediator effect at fixed embeddings.
Global mean cancellation near zero can remove amplitude in radius cells; report frequency and norm shortfall. Existing normalized cell has a different raw-norm fallback.

The residual head already sees static and pooled features. A gain can reflect useful factorization, conditioning or optimization rather than new information. Raw norm is not DIN activation mass and does not identify a psychological intensity variable.
Context-query cells retain target-dependent match groups; they test query construction, not an entirely target-independent model.
Pooled_reference matches allocated capacity and forward arithmetic, not active scorer capacity or measured backward cost; raw_pooled_duplicate remains a separate active capacity control.

cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Three new full-protocol cells, estimated 3*1100=3300s, worst-case 3*1760.9324=5282.7973s; include diagnostics, failures and preparation. No local training or screening. Reuse frozen raw/normalized cells to avoid redundant seed-42 executions.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least 8500s for validation-only paired seeds 43/44 of the incumbent and closest 2-3 discriminating controls/source bests (up to eight repeats near 1050s), subject to actual ledger; retain existing seed42 results with matching hashes. Freeze exact source/config/seed suite before host repetition. Host exposes no test. If worst-case attribution costs leave insufficient reserve, reduce repetition suite and explicitly report preliminary comparisons rather than changing limits. Priority suite: raw_target, radius_target, pooled_reference and pooled_observed with paired seeds43/44 (eight additional runs); radius_context repetitions only if actual costs fit. The weaker balanced_target source remains a seed42 utility reference if not repeated.
cost_plan.stop_rule: No new branch after these replacements until actual costs/outcomes reviewed. Stop at ledger limit or before a complete admissible unit plus necessary assessment fits. Never duplicate unknown-state calls, raise caps or claim success from exhaustion. Omitted paired repetitions and unavailable user-cluster intervals remain explicit limitations.
